blocks.text: The Residence at Homewood is a private mental health and addiction treatment center in Guelph, Ontario, known for its personalized, medically supervised care in a peaceful and confidential setting. Located on the spacious 50-acre campus of the respected Homewood Health Centre, it offers support to individuals dealing with anxiety, depression, trauma, PTSD, addiction, and burnout. Every person receives a treatment plan tailored to their specific needs, which may include therapy sessions, psychiatric support, innovative treatments like rTMS or ketamine therapy, and wellness activities such as yoga, fitness, mindfulness, and nutrition. Guests stay in comfortable, private rooms and enjoy meals prepared by in-house chefs, all within a calm, welcoming environment designed to promote healing. With a compassionate team of experienced professionals and a strong focus on personalized care, The Residence at Homewood offers a safe space where people can focus on their recovery and take meaningful steps toward a healthier life.

Frequently Asked Questions About Homewood Health

Where is The Residence at Homewood located?

It’s right in Guelph, Ontario, nestled on a peaceful 50-acre campus alongside the well-regarded Homewood Health Centre.

What kinds of treatment do you offer?

They provide a range of care—including intensive inpatient programs, detox services, and 1-on-1 counselling for issues like addiction, anxiety, depression, PTSD, OCD, and trauma.

How long will I be there?

Typical program durations run between 6–9 weeks, although this can shift depending on your individual needs and treatment progress.

What does it cost, and do you accept insurance?

They recommend chatting with their intake team to get all the details. Costs vary based on your treatment plan, and you’ll want to ask about insurance coverage or payment options early on.

What should I bring with me?

Just the essentials are needed:

  • Your provincial health card and photo ID

  • A few days’ supply of prescription meds

  • Weather-appropriate clothes

  • A few personal items to feel comfortable
